comparison.objective: Seat and trim a wire in a 110 insulation-displacement contact; candidate removes a crimp terminal from a connector housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient a punch-down tool, drive wire into an IDC and cut the correct loose end versus bend wire, insert a single blade beneath a locking tab and withdraw tool and wire together.
comparison.success_condition: Wire seated with contact engagement, loose end trimmed, run not cut and tool lifted; candidate requires terminal exit without crimp separation, housing damage or neighbor release. Candidate numeric thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: This is the closest wire-tool record, but it tests termination by downward punch/cut rather than latch release and extraction.
